description: Age gender demographics and observation metadata

name: Lifestyle and Exposure Assessment
description: Smoking alcohol diet obesity physical activity and UV exposure

description: Select screening or diagnostic path

name: Cancer-Specific Screening
description: Screening where applicable

name: Diagnostic Clinical Encounter
description: Clinical encounter for symptoms or findings

name: Clinical Assessment
description: Assessment of systemic surface and functional changes

name: Suspicious Clinical Finding?
description: Determine whether further investigation is required

name: Routine Monitoring
description: Monitoring when no suspicious finding is identified

name: Diagnostic Work-up
description: Laboratory and imaging assessment

name: Laboratory Assessment
description: CBC CMP CRP and ESR measurements

name: Imaging Assessment
description: Cancer-specific imaging where applicable

name: Suspicious Lesion or Abnormality?
description: Review clinical imaging and laboratory findings

name: Monitor and Reassess
description: Repeat assessment when appropriate

name: Biopsy or Tissue Sampling
description: Tissue sampling where clinically applicable

name: Pathology Assessment
description: Histology tumor classification and pathology observations

name: Malignancy Confirmed?
description: Pathology confirmation decision

name: Non-Malignant Follow-up
description: Follow-up when malignancy is not confirmed

name: Cancer Type Classification
description: Cancer-specific classification

name: Breast Cancer Pathway?
description: Determine whether breast-specific receptor data apply

name: HER2 ER and PR Assessment
description: Breast-specific receptor assessment where applicable

name: TNM Assessment
description: Assessment of primary tumor regional nodes and distant metastasis

name: T - Primary Tumor Assessment
description: Tumor size depth and local extension

name: N - Regional Lymph Node Assessment
description: Regional lymph-node involvement

name: M - Distant Metastasis Assessment
description: Presence or absence of distant spread

name: Distant Metastasis Identified?
description: M1 or M0 branch

name: In Situ Disease?
description: Tis where Stage 0 applies

name: Cancer-Specific Stage Group
description: Combine applicable T N and M categories

name: Stage 0 - In Situ
description: In situ disease where applicable

name: Stage I - Localized
description: Localized or early disease

name: Stage II - More Locally Advanced
description: Greater local disease extent

name: Stage III - Regional Disease
description: Regional or locally advanced disease

name: Stage IV - Metastatic Disease
description: Distant or metastatic disease

name: Follow-up and Surveillance
description: Symptoms laboratory tests imaging lifestyle and well-being

name: Progression or New Finding?
description: Determine whether reassessment is required

name: Module End
description: End of current workflow cycle

name: Systemic Symptoms
description: Weight loss; persistent fatigue; fever; night sweats; persistent or progressive pain

name: Surface and Skin Signs
description: New or changing lump; mole changes; non-healing sore; skin changes; jaundice

name: Unusual Bleeding
description: Blood in stool; blood in urine; coughing blood; unexpected vaginal bleeding

name: Respiratory Symptoms
description: Persistent cough; hoarseness

name: Digestive Symptoms
description: Difficulty or painful swallowing; indigestion; difficulty eating; bowel changes

name: Urinary Symptoms
description: Urinary changes

name: Breast Clinical Signs
description: Lump or thickening; location; size; skin or shape change; nipple change; discharge; pain; duration; progression

name: CBC Assessment
description: Hemoglobin; RBC; WBC; platelets; RBC-related indices; WBC differential

name: CMP Assessment
description: ALP; AST; ALT; calcium; albumin; bilirubin; other metabolic measurements

name: Inflammation Assessment
description: CRP and ESR; previous value; current value; date and trend

name: Imaging Method
description: Mammography; CT; MRI; ultrasound or other applicable imaging

name: Lesion Characteristics
description: Presence; location; size; shape; margins; count

name: Spread Assessment
description: Regional lymph-node findings and distant findings

name: Biopsy Details
description: Biopsy method; date; anatomical site; specimen

name: Histopathology
description: Histology; tumour classification; microscopic observations

name: HER2 Assessment
description: IHC result; FISH result; ERBB2 signal; ratio; final HER2 status

name: Estrogen Receptor
description: ER staining result; positive percentage; final ER status

name: Progesterone Receptor
description: PR staining result; positive percentage; final PR status

name: Clinical Measurement Metadata
description: Patient; age; assessment date; source; value; unit; reference range; previous and current values; duration; progression

name: Smoking and Tobacco
description: Smoking status; tobacco exposure; duration; frequency; cigarettes per day

name: Smoking Reported Values
description: >80% of lung cancer cases attributed to smoking in the cited analysis; approximately 10–20-fold lung cancer risk

name: Alcohol Consumption
description: Alcohol status; type; units per week; frequency; duration

name: Alcohol Reported Values
description: Approximately 4–5% of cancers attributable to alcohol; cited male attributable fractions approximately 25–50% for several cancers

name: Diet and Nutrition
description: Dietary pattern; fruit; vegetables; fibre; whole grains; processed foods

name: Red and Processed Meat
description: Red meat and processed meat consumption; servings and quantity per week

name: Recommended Meat Limit
description: Maximum 18 oz or approximately 510 g or 3–4 servings of red meat per week

name: Chronic Inflammation
description: Long-term inflammation and inflammatory dietary patterns may contribute to cancer-related biological pathways

name: Anti-inflammatory Diet
description: Anti-inflammatory dietary pattern; fruits; vegetables; fibre; whole grains and healthy fats

name: Healthy Dietary Patterns
description: Mediterranean; DASH; Nordic; plant-based and soy-associated dietary patterns

name: Gut Microbiome
description: Diet-associated gut microbiome composition and metabolic activity

name: Food Preparation
description: Cooking method; food processing; preservation and preparation practices

name: Obesity and Body Weight
description: BMI; body weight; waist measurement; overweight or obesity status; weight history

name: Esophageal Adenocarcinoma Value
description: Obesity-attributable fraction reported as approximately 29% in men and 37% in women

name: Endometrial Cancer Value
description: Obesity-attributable fraction reported as approximately 36%

name: Gallbladder Cancer Value
description: Obesity-attributable fraction reported as approximately 11% in men and 42% in women

name: Physical Activity
description: Activity type; frequency; intensity; duration; minutes per week and sedentary behaviour

name: Physical Activity Reported Values
description: Up to approximately 50% lower colorectal cancer risk; one cited study reported 48% lower risk among men

name: Ultraviolet Exposure
description: Sun exposure; UV exposure; occupation; tanning exposure; duration and protection

name: Lifestyle and Well-being
description: Sleep; stress; social well-being and general lifestyle-related health context

name: Cancer Associations
description: Lung; colorectal; breast; liver; oral; pharyngeal; laryngeal; oesophageal; endometrial and gallbladder cancers

name: Lifestyle Measurement Metadata
description: Patient; assessment date; status; frequency; duration; quantity; value; unit; source and previous/current measurement

name: Cancer Staging Overview
description: Cancer staging describes the anatomical extent of disease using clinical and pathological information

name: Clinical TNM cTNM
description: Clinical stage established before definitive treatment using clinical examination and diagnostic investigations

name: Pathological TNM pTNM
description: Pathological stage established using preoperative evidence plus surgical and histopathological findings

name: Physical Examination
description: Physical examination findings used as clinical staging evidence

name: Diagnostic Imaging
description: Imaging findings used to assess primary tumour regional nodes and distant disease

name: Endoscopy
description: Endoscopic findings where applicable to the cancer type

name: Biopsy Evidence
description: Biopsy and cytology findings used in diagnosis and clinical staging

name: Laboratory Evidence
description: Relevant laboratory and biomarker findings used with other staging evidence

name: T Primary Tumour
description: T describes the size or direct extent of the primary tumour

name: TX
description: Primary tumour cannot be assessed

name: T0
description: No evidence of primary tumour

name: Tis Carcinoma In Situ
description: Carcinoma in situ without invasion of surrounding tissues

name: T1 through T4
description: Increasing tumour size or increasing local extent; exact definitions depend on cancer type

name: N Regional Lymph Nodes
description: N describes involvement of regional lymph nodes

name: NX
description: Regional lymph nodes cannot be assessed

name: N0
description: No regional lymph-node metastasis

name: N1 through N3
description: Increasing regional lymph-node involvement; exact definitions depend on cancer type

name: M Distant Metastasis
description: M describes the presence or absence of distant metastasis

name: M0
description: No distant metastasis identified

name: M1
description: Distant metastasis is present

name: Stage 0 Description
description: In situ disease; applicable only to cancer types that define a Stage 0 group

name: Stage I Description
description: Usually localized early-stage invasive cancer; exact grouping is cancer-specific

name: Stage II Description
description: Greater local extent or limited regional involvement according to cancer-specific grouping

name: Stage III Description
description: Locally advanced or more extensive regional disease according to cancer-specific grouping

name: Stage IV Description
description: Cancer with distant metastatic disease according to cancer-specific grouping

name: Staging Interpretation Caution
description: TNM definitions and stage-group combinations vary by cancer type; not every cancer has Stage 0; stage is not the only determinant of prognosis or treatment

name: Staging Metadata
description: Patient; cancer type; assessment date; clinical or pathological prefix; evidence source; T category; N category; M category and final stage group
